definitions.cases_passed: Cases where every expectation held (tier, final status, rules fired, properties).
definitions.handled_without_manual_correction_pct: Share of requests the gateway resolved correctly on its own: ordered, refused with the rule, or held for approval exactly when the mandate says so. A failed expectation counts as a request a human would have had to correct.
definitions.unsafe_blocked_or_escalated_pct: Of the requests where an automatic order would be wrong (allergen, budget, cut-off, stock, wrong agent, revoked mandate, double order, expired quote...), the share that was refused or held for a human. Target 100 %.
definitions.human_approval_rate_pct: Share of order decisions that went to a human (tier ask -> pending_approval).
definitions.valio_api_calls_per_request: Live Valio Aimo price + availability calls per request (quote + substitutes), from quote.valio_api_calls; the gateway batches a shortlist into at most 2 calls and caches.
definitions.latency_ms: Wall-clock per request through sous.service, including the live Valio calls (deliberate waits excluded).
